about.text: A hard, pressed Sicilian cow's-milk cheese in wheels of 5 to 20 kg, often flavoured with chili or black pepper. The milk is warmed to about 35 °C and set with kid or lamb rennet paste; the moulds are then put in whey at about 85 °C, and the cheese is aged 3 to 18 months, turned and rubbed with salted water.
